supersedes_recommendation_only: The concrete root native-supervisor/spool candidate is now judged preferable to the frozen V baseline generic in-process A. V facts/equations/HOLD and all source bytes remain unchanged.

options.label: Pinned native supervisor plus bounded spool transport
options.structure: One fixed native console supervisor per reached child, owning one unnamed Job Object and two private synchronous pipe workers with preallocated4096-byte read arrays. No managed per-inner async task/pool/registration graph. Parent has no redirected supervisor stdout/stderr and reads only admitted bounded spool/terminal files after the supervisor reports terminal state or exits.
options.containment: Prefer creation-time PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_JOB_LIST with the job already configured KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE and no breakaway flags, combined with an exact handle inheritance list. The selected platform must qualify Windows10+/supported attribute. CREATE_SUSPENDED may still be used for setup ordering, but CreateSuspended->Assign alone is not atomic containment against supervisor death.
options.benefit: Eliminates both parent fragmented async-wrapper creation and host-wide KillTree enumeration by source. Process/cancellation/file/error state is a finite purpose-owned graph whose explicit native/CRT/stack costs can be counted.
options.new_obligations: New binary/input/source/ABI/native association, fixed request/result protocol and spool artifacts, whole source-operation funding and complete32MiB joined accounting. Supervisor cost is not exempt because it is another process. No size/fit/GO result is supplied here.

options.label: Controller-owned in-process job and two dedicated synchronous workers
options.structure: A small pinned controller component owns the same creation-time job containment and two dedicated synchronous read workers/preallocated read buffers, with explicit cancellation and bounded joins, preserving rooted quarantine in the controller.
options.benefit: Avoids a new supervisor/spool protocol and keeps actual target raw-exit observation in the controller.
options.tradeoff: Managed thread/worker/exception/native-stack joins remain in the same controller. An unsettled synchronous I/O worker must retain its buffer/component and can outlive the child; cancellation is not guaranteed. It also needs whole resource/source/ABI funding and cannot claim physical-free credit.

options.label: Owned job and fixed native overlapped named-pipe state
options.structure: The same native supervisor or in-process component uses genuinely overlapped named pipes with one preallocated OVERLAPPED/event/read buffer per pipe and a source-owned finite state machine.
options.benefit: Can avoid two dedicated read-worker stacks and per-inner tasks.
options.tradeoff: Anonymous CreatePipe pipes do not support overlapped operations; a named-pipe design requires its own bounded unique-name/security/connection protocol and cancellation-completion/lifetime proof. Cancellation return is not completion. This is a larger first critic obligation than S1.

requirements.required: Configure the unnamed private job before CreateProcess; specify job membership during process creation with the admitted attribute, or supply another reviewed creator-death-safe containment proof. Do not claim a suspended but unassigned process is contained. Every create/attribute/assign/resume failure must preserve explicit observed/unknown cleanup state and refuse certification.

The supervisor is the sole intended job-handle owner. The job handle is noninheritable and absent from the child handle list; it is not copied to the parent, target, descendants or a named reopenable channel. Pass only exact owned stdin/null and stdout/stderr child pipe handles. No breakaway flags or silent fallback. Last-handle closure initiates termination; it is not an observed-settlement receipt.

Drain both pipes concurrently; neither worker may wait for child exit before reading. Reuse fixed buffers regardless of one-byte fragmentation, arbitrary output timing or cap overflow. Preserve per-pipe raw prefixes, shared per-child1MiB retained-log cap, observed/retained/omitted/unknown accounting, current before-write complete-stage-pool admission and raw-output failure handling. No quiet-output premise, cap increase or new legitimate-input refusal is allowed.

Observe actual target process exit/bit-exact32-bit exit code separately from supervisor exit. Normal completion requires both read workers/requests settled, spool writes flushed/admitted and the owned job population settled under a valid current accounting query/other reviewed proof. Do not treat a generic job wait or a missing completion-port notification as all processes exited; both APIs have narrower documented semantics.

Parent may kill only the known supervisor process handle. Job close is a cleanup action, not proof of descendants reaped, buffers freed, raw output complete or target exit observed. Missing/malformed/partial terminal data, supervisor crash, timeout, unresolved native I/O or absent settlement proof sets unknown/quarantine and prevents another child; preserve all spool files and diagnostic owners. No next stage or success is synthesized from supervisor exit0 alone.

Cancellation and job termination may fail to settle I/O before the bounded wait. Never recycle or free a buffer/OVERLAPPED/worker state while native I/O can still reference it. Retain rooted owners or conservatively quarantine the abnormal supervisor branch. A source shutdown path may not use unbounded retries while claiming the original1800s body plus bounded cleanup schedule.

Define one small versioned exact request and terminal record with bounded path/argv/file extents, child name/index, manifest/run identity, target binary identity, explicit observed flags and numeric raw codes. Avoid arbitrary native error text/JSON growth. Verify exact length/schema/kind/EOF/current identity. Add every new input and spool/temporary artifact to a new source manifest and complete filesystem/fence/reparse/hash/primary-secondary ownership correspondence. Preserve the original target PE checks and binary before/after fences; checking only the supervisor is insufficient.

Count supervisor source work, all native/static/heap buffers, two worker stacks and handles, job/attribute/kernel/CRT/TLS/cold owners under the adopted whole accounting convention, parent polling/wrappers, file transport reads/writes and all retained failed-attempt branches. Derive a joined phase lifetime upper; no per-process exemption, compiler-opacity extension, GC/Dispose/close free credit or fit claim from cumulative slack.

Fixed console supervisor and already gated console target use CREATE_NO_WINDOW, no shell, no interactive stdin and no GUI/input/foreground/device APIs, with reviewed inherited OS error-dialog policy. Do not claim these flags contain arbitrary GUI programs; only the admitted fixed source/binary profile is in scope. Any future app drive still needs the repository separate-session policy.

Write the in-scope architecture/protocol/resource proposal and obtain independent critic review first. A separately reviewed compile-only purpose lane may qualify the supervisor source/object/binary and ABI. Only a fresh complete source/native/resource/binding review plus root gate can authorize any later program/Clock attempt; no implementation or execution is authorized by this options packet.

failure_cases.case: supervisor dies after suspended Create before manual Assign
failure_cases.manual_sequence: Unassigned suspended child can survive; unsupported atomic-containment claim.
failure_cases.S1_requirement: Creation-time job assignment or a separately proved creator-death-safe protocol.

failure_cases.manual_sequence: Supervisor death does not close the last handle; KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE inference fails.
failure_cases.S1_requirement: Noninheritable private handle plus exact inherited stdio list.

failure_cases.case: supervisor killed or terminal record partly written
failure_cases.manual_sequence: Target raw exit/descendant settlement is not inferred.
failure_cases.S1_requirement: Quarantine/unknown; preserve files; forbid next child.

failure_cases.case: target or descendant keeps stderr write handle open after target exit
failure_cases.manual_sequence: Pipe read may remain pending despite target exit.
failure_cases.S1_requirement: Concurrent drain, bounded cancellation/settlement and retained/quarantined owners.

failure_cases.manual_sequence: Same two fixed native read arrays are reused; iteration count still requires source work sponsorship.
failure_cases.S1_requirement: No per-byte task/node allocation and no output-silence assumption.

failure_cases.case: job assignment feature unavailable or incompatible nesting
failure_cases.manual_sequence: No silent breakaway or resume-before-containment fallback.
failure_cases.S1_requirement: Fail before running the target and preserve raw refusal; platform feature remains an explicit qualification.

failure_cases.case: both pipes race the shared cap or a spool write fails
failure_cases.manual_sequence: A successful reservation does not prove bytes were written; a failure must not disappear.
failure_cases.S1_requirement: Single source-owned cap/accounting protocol distinguishes observed, reserved, written, omitted and unknown bytes; identical per-pipe prefix semantics.

bootstrap_fix.old_source: Process.GetCurrentProcess().MainModule reaches module enumeration, native module metadata and growing pointer arrays. Its selected implementation removes a leading extended-length prefix before exposing FileName.
bootstrap_fix.new_source: Environment.ProcessPath caches a Windows GetModuleFileNameW(NULL) result from a260-character initial stack buffer, growing a ValueStringBuilder only if truncated. The Windows API identifies the executable of the current process directly; no process/module census is involved.
bootstrap_fix.supported_narrow_hypothesis: Under the same exact trusted fresh-launcher/immutable runtime path profile, reject null/query failure, preserve the old leading extended-prefix treatment and the same OrdinalIgnoreCase expected executable comparison. The admitted fixed executable path is 101 UTF16 units, so that selected successful direct query fits its initial260-character buffer. This is a source-profile implication, not a live ProcessPath observation or a global resource bound for arbitrary executable paths.
bootstrap_fix.not_claimed: The property source has no hard growth cap, can be initialized concurrently and is cached; renamed/deleted-executable behavior is expressly undefined by its own remarks. It does not provide operationally identical API failure behavior or unconditional equivalence for arbitrary path aliases/prefixes/mutations. No silent path canonicalization, relaxed identity or host/runtime version inference is authorized.
bootstrap_fix.strict_bounded_alternative: If the profile is insufficient for the chosen whole proof, a separately reviewed tiny direct GetModuleFileNameW(NULL) binding with a fixed expected-length-plus-prefix/NUL buffer may reject truncation before any growth; its new binding/storage/error source must be counted. That is a further source hypothesis, not authored here.
bootstrap_fix.baseline_unchanged: R_controller_module_census remains HOLD in the frozen V baseline until a concrete successor source and whole functional/resource review accept its actual replacement.

bounded_next_step: Root chooses the source design, then author a concrete ADR/protocol/state/owner/cost proposal for independent critic review; no target/helper source or compile/run is authorized by this packet.
